_comment: PLACEHOLDER for CI only — not a Firebase project, not a secret.
The real google-services.json is per-environment config and is gitignored,
so a fresh CI checkout has none. :app:processDebugGoogleServices gates
compileDebugKotlin, so without a well-formed file here the compile task
cannot run at all. Type-checking Kotlin needs the file to parse, not to
address a live project. Set the GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON repo secret to build
against the real one instead; the workflow prefers it when present.
